residual_uncertainty: Preview entries were not run here; the orchestrator's run against the preview is the one that counts. The same nine commands pass against the manifest entrypoint started locally (supplementary only).

local-all picks the server zone by the current UTC hour: UTC+14 from 12:00 UTC (exercised live in this session, which ran at about 12:30 UTC), UTC-12 before 12:00 UTC (checked arithmetically for every minute of a UTC day, evidence/f2_zone_choice_check.out, but not run live). POSIX TZ strings are used so no tzdata is needed. Correct code ignores TZ entirely, so the choice cannot make a correct server fail.

The F-1 regression test makes the interleaving deterministic by wrapping app.storage.asdict (the spec defines to_dict as asdict(self) plus overdue). The probabilistic in-process probe (evidence/probe_race_post_response.py) independently shows 0 torn responses in 120000 rounds at HEAD against 18-67 per run at the round-1 head.
